first.why: Studies on steps tested for the first time are Type II.

higher.why: Replacing studies with a higher-risk assessment is Type II.

same.why: Replacing obsolete studies with the same or lower risk is Type IB.

pass.why: A new name or address for the batch release manufacturer is Type IA-IN.

fail.why: A condition is not met. A change that is not Type IA or Type II is a Type IB by default (the default for other variations).

pass.why: A new name or address for another site is Type IA.

fail.why: A condition is not met. A change that is not Type IA or Type II is a Type IB by default (the default for other variations).

tree.why: Switzerland has no local representative: the authorisation holder itself must be established in Switzerland. A new pharmacovigilance contact is reported by the holder, not as a variation.

pass.why: A new name for the active substance, with the substance unchanged, is Type IA-IN.

fail.why: A condition is not met. A change that is not Type IA or Type II is a Type IB by default (the default for other variations).

strength.why: Deleting a strength is Type IB.

pack.why: Deleting a pack size, with the remaining sizes fitting the dosing, is Type IA.
pack.note: Check the sub-item letter in the guidelines.
